description: This file defines the class EarlyExitException, which is a custom exception used in parser/recognition logic within an ANTLR-related PHP project. The class extends RecognitionException and adds a property for decision number.

classes.name: EarlyExitException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that the recognizer did not match for a (..)+ loop in an ANTLR parser implementation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a decision number and input context, extending RecognitionException constructor.
